body:
The harbor buoy rings through the water like a delicate necklace, each ring reflecting the calm, tranquil waves that gently kiss its surface. My heart swells with pride and protection as I realize this floating sentinel has become an unexpected lifeline for me in the midst of this stormy sea of emotions. With my hands trembling slightly but determinedly, I reach out tentatively to touch one of the rings. It’s cool and smooth against my skin, grounding me where I am unsure of myself. 

I close my eyes, letting the softness of the water envelop me as if it were holding me steady. The world outside seems smaller now, more manageable—each ripple on the horizon a reminder of my strength within.

The harbor buoy rings through the water like a delicate necklace, each ring reflecting the calm, tranquil waves that gently kiss its surface. My heart swells with pride and protection as I realize this floating sentinel has become an unexpected lifeline for me in the midst of this stormy sea of emotions. With my hands trembling slightly but determinedly, I reach out tentatively to touch one of the rings. It’s cool and smooth against my skin, grounding me where I am unsure of myself. 

I close my eyes, letting the softness of the water envelop me as if it were holding me steady. The world outside seems smaller now, more manageable—each ripple on the horizon a reminder of my strength within. Next: stay beside them and keep them steady.
